children: Director David Rees-Jones reported purchasing 100,000 shares of Suncrete Class A Common Stock through the David G Rees-Jones 2012 Family Trust on Nov. 19, 2026, at a weighted average price of $6.49 per share, for a total purchase amount of $649,000. Rees-Jones is the trust’s co-trustee and sole beneficiary and disclaims beneficial ownership of the trust’s shares except to the extent of his pecuniary interest. Following the transaction, he indirectly owned 216,470 shares through the trust.
